name: Walsin Technology Corporation
summary: Walsin Technology Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, develops, manufactures, and sells passive electronic components in Asia, America, and Europe. It provides chip capacitors, chip resistors, ceramic dielectric powders, and magnetic elements. It also researches, develops, manufactures, and sells integrated electrical protection components, hybrid microwave antenna modules, electric capacitors, thick film printed circuit boards, laminated dielectric filters, and multilayer type microwave communication components and modules; generates solar power electricity; sells photoelectric and sensor devices, and radio frequency devices; and trades in electronic parts.
